services.name: Rascal Charters
services.desc: Welcome to your exclusive day of adventure on the water! Our Private Charters offer you and your group the chance to explore Maui charter fishing at your own pace. For special occasions or peaceful outings, Rascal Charters is ready to make your dream fishing trip a reality. When deep sea fishing Maui-style, we specialize in trolling for Hawaii’s top game fish. That means chasing: If conditions allow, we can also mix in live bait techniques to boost your odds of landing a bucket-list catch! Got a special request? Let us know, and we’ll do our best to accommodate your ideal Maui fishing

blurb: Guests fish for Marlin, Ahi (yellowfin tuna), Ono (wahoo), and Mahi-Mahi (dorado) off Maui. Trips include trolling and can adapt with live bait on request. The boat is a 43-ft Bertram Sportfisher with air conditioning and shaded deck areas.
